events.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
events.summary: Hi Anglers, As I am waiting on Steam's official approval, I wanted to confirm that the game has been thoroughly tested on the Steam Deck, and it plays great. Testing criteria:The text size is comfortable to read on the Deck's screen The correct input glyphs are displayed when an input is required A virtual keyboard appears when entering the text chat window There are no lag spikes or performance issues The UI isn't a pain to navigate That said: get cozy, grab a drink, and enjoy the game!
